parameters.name: Codes
parameters.description: An array of workspace role codes.

parameters.name: Names
parameters.description: An array of workspace role names.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: ProjectId
parameters.description:
The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can find the ID on the Workspace Management page in the [DataWorks console](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console).

This parameter specifies the DataWorks workspace for which you want to list roles.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the workspace role.

- `UserCustom`: Custom Role

- `System`: System Role
